scripts.generate:grammar: npm run sync:core && antlr-ng -Dlanguage=TypeScript --exact-output-dir -o src/generated grammar/InsightLexer.g4 grammar/InsightParser.g4 && node scripts/strip-generated-whitespace.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-test-suite.mjs contracts
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-test-suite.mjs runtime
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:prepare && c8 --all --src=build/runtime --include='build/runtime/**/*.js' --exclude='build/runtime/generated/**' --exclude='build/runtime/contracts.js' --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary --reports-dir=coverage node scripts/run-test-suite.mjs runtime
scripts.verify: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:check
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run verify
